title: I feel scammed
body: Could not access the settings or account section for weeks, so it was impossible to manage or cancel my subscription properly. I also noticed that I was charged for two subscriptions even though I only intended to purchase one. Overall, this was a very frustrating experience and far too expensive for what the apps offer. There are much better and cheaper alternatives available. I would not recommend this app.
author: Didi27x
